units.source_text: 吟罢又说：“屈指数来，一别至今，已积年累月。

en.t: When he had finished reciting, he said again, "Counting on my fingers, it has already been many months and years since we parted.

units.source_text: 京中变迁甚多，处处令人感慨。

en.t: There have been many changes in the capital, and everywhere one goes, they stir deep emotion.

units.source_text: 今后稍得闲暇，当将年来颠沛流离之状，向你详细诉说。

en.t: When I have a little leisure from now on, I shall tell you in detail about the hardships and wandering I have endured over these years.

units.source_text: 你在此间，这几年来春花秋月，如何等闲度送，想除我之外亦无人可告。

en.t: As for you here, how idly and sadly you must have passed the spring blossoms and autumn moons of these past years; I imagine there is no one but me to whom you could tell it.

units.source_text: 我妄自作此猜想，但恐未必有当吧。”

en.t: I am only making this guess on my own, though I fear it may not necessarily be correct."
